# Template values

<!-- Generated by tests/gen_values.py from the Objects tree; don't edit by hand. -->

Every value a notification's title, contents or condition can use, as the template editor's **Objects** pane lists it. A value that isn't there (no print job, a printer without that part) reads `n/a` and is false in `{% if %}`. Numbers in names (`job.filament2`, `printer.extruder1`) are per toolhead or filament. Which printers have each value: [values by printer](values-by-printer.md). The file format for a whole notification: [notification files](notification-files.md).
